issues: The thread entered from the middle of the hero and threw one big loop straight across the headline, so it read as a stray scribble and not a strand running from giver to wearer. Further down there was no visible route at all until you scrolled.
The hero headline was clamped to 11ch at 7.6rem, so it broke as 'haarwerkspe-cialist'. hyphens:auto also split section titles mid-word ('professi-onele').
Stations 02, 05 and 06 showed only a hollow number with no heading, which left empty, unfinished section starts and no mill vocabulary.
The spindle rail was made of short per-bobbin segments covering about 60% of the width. With one category (stress brand) it turned into a lonely stub.
The process stamps overlapped with negative margins and tiny roman numerals, so they read as a smudge instead of five distinct stamps ending in a brand-coloured check.
Section padding was up to 150px top and bottom, giving about 300px dead bands between stations that killed the rhythm.
The hank strands ran behind the hero paragraph and made the text harder to read.
fixed: The thread now enters at the left gutter, a faint dotted 'un-spun' guide shows the whole route ahead, and a small bobbin tip rides the end of the spun strand, so the scroll-spinning reads at a glance.

The hero h1 is resized to fit (5.7vw, max 6.3rem) with no ch clamp, hyphens:manual and text-wrap:balance on every display heading. Hero type gets a paper-coloured halo so it stays legible over the hank.

Every station now has a mono mill label under its number (SORT, COMB, KNOT, PASSPORT, WEARER) and a ruled head. 02 shows the catalog intro as a serif statement, 05 shows the story eyebrow plus a dashed passport issue tag, and 06 shows a dashed 'to wearer' tag.
The spindle is now one continuous full-width rail with end caps and bigger bobbins that share the width, so it looks complete with 1 or 8 categories.
The stamps are separate double-ring rubber stamps with alternating tilt, and the last one is a brand-colour check stamp (home and catalog).
Section padding is tightened to clamp(56px,7vw,100px) for a steadier station rhythm.
